newsitem.title: UK: DFS gains as results beat forecasts.
newsitem.headline: DFS gains as results beat forecasts.

text.p: Shares in Britain's DFS Furniture Co Plc rose nine pence to 541-1/2 as the company reported results which were just ahead of market forecasts, dealers said.
DFS reported first-half pre-tax profit rose 23.6 percent to 18.7 million stg. Market forecasts had centred on a figure of 18 million stg, dealers said.
"There is a sense of relief," a trader said.
The better-than-expected results came after DFS shares had recently been depressed by fears of disappointing profits.
The shares had been in a steady downtrend since mid-March and fell to a nine-month low of 503-1/2 pence on April 15.
